abstract.p: This paper presents a strategy for improving AI assistants embedded in short e-learning courses. The proposed method is implemented within a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture and evaluated using several retrieval variants. The results show that query quality improves when the knowledge base is enriched with definitions of key concepts discussed in the course. Our main contribution is a lightweight enhancement approach that increases response quality without overloading the course with additional instructional content.
